answer: Because the rationale is hashed into the terrace record and indexed in the oasis history, the nectar audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 4 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. Filling 55 aliases as a result needs 55 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
